## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results.

- [ ] Backend `npx prisma generate` and `npm run build`
- [ ] Frontend `npm run lint` and `npm run build`
- [ ] Manual/API/UI verification where relevant
- [ ] Documentation or configuration syntax checked where relevant

## Security and Data Safety

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials, or private data are included.
- [ ] Environment variable changes are documented without publishing values.
- [ ] Role boundaries, authentication, and input validation were considered.
- [ ] Database and deployment impact is described, if applicable.

## Reviewer Notes

Call out known limitations, follow-up work, migration steps, or areas that need special review.
